title: Spiced Black Bean & Lentil Soup
description: A hearty two-legume soup with cumin, smoked paprika and tomato — freezer-friendly and budget-easy.
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic, carrots and pepper until softened.
Stir in the spices, then add the beans, lentils, tomatoes and broth.
Simmer 15 minutes, then finish with cilantro and lime juice.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste high-protein recipe collection

notes: Two legumes together roughly triple the satiety of a single-bean soup at the same calorie count.
